title: Controls.
officialText:
Recirculating direct-fired air heaters shall be equipped with airflow-sensing devices, safety shutoff devices,
operating temperature controls and thermally actuated temperature limit controls in accordance with the terms of their listing.
SECTION FGC 613
CLOTHES DRYERS
